title: Breaking run: The Hacker News, 'CISA Confirms Active Exploitation of Two PHP2Shell Flaws' and the 46 sources it cites that the newsroom had not captured
note: Started by the editor at about 19:00 UTC on 27 October 2026 ('breaking: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/cisa-confirms-active-exploitation-of.html ... lots of really good sources here that we should have captured'). State found at 19:05 UTC: the article is not in the source watch (7r83qic5 at 92b154eef490) or the evidence vault (nnd3i8iw at d21ea5df2a32); of its 49 outbound sources, 3 are held (CISA's alert of 26 October, php.net's release notes of 21 and 26 October) and 46 are new: about 40 vendor advisories (ABB to WordPress), CISA's KEV catalog page, Censys, W3Techs, Microsoft (CVE-2026-111497, .NET), an X post and broccoli2shell.com. The researcher, curator, journalist and correspondent schedules are paused for the move to a new account (conductor-0016), so no other writer is active on either vault. Steps: 1 researcher (add and capture the article and the new sources; queue them), 2 curator (promote into nnd3i8iw; export to data), 3 journalist (verdicts), 4 correspondent (review; what it changes on the site). Each release carries Agent: breaking@php.newsroom, Role: <step> and a To-<agent> note. Done at 19:54 UTC: four steps released (watch 7r83qic5 6b4b201bf16b; evidence nnd3i8iw 6f0d5c50bf12; data cb27954, 8298fb3, 105ad82; site 90920989, aa40f6a1; updates 4b1828a, state of affairs v5). Waiting on the lanes' reviews at their first wakes after the move, and on 15 pages the watch could not capture (5 PDFs, 3 bot-challenged, 1 down, 6 empty renders) plus Asustor's AS-2026-023.
